positions.sentence: Users are personally responsible for their own use of AI tools and for what happens with the accounts or agents they use.
The university is not responsible for personal data, consequences or negligence arising from users' individual use of external or unsanctioned AI tools.
People who accept click-through agreements with university credentials without delegated signature authority may face personal consequences.
Users should not use their university accounts to sign up for AI tools, and staff must not use tools not cleared by InfoSec.
Users must review the terms and conditions of AI software before using it.
Users whose AI outputs violate others' intellectual property are responsible for the damage and may face disciplinary sanctions.
A person unlinked to the university who causes damage alone answers for it, exonerating the university, and is barred from using the technology there.
